sources.name: modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk
sources.reason: Real v2.0.0 spike confirmed Streamable HTTP compatibility but required an ASGI/custom identity middleware adapter to preserve bearer-bound org/user authorization and added 28 transitive packages for a PoC surface limited to initialize, tools/list, and tools/call. The existing stdlib transport remains covered by live protocol/auth/schema regressions; revisit when OAuth, SSE/resumption, or a broader MCP surface is required.
